issues.issue: Is paragraph 117(9)(d) of the Regulations authorized by section 14 of IRPA?
issues.applicant_position: Regulation exceeds s.14: misrepresentation sanctions belong to Division 4, and the sponsorship right is substantive.
issues.result_quote: I can find nothing express or implied in either section 14, or the scheme of IRPA, to reduce the apparent breadth of the regulation-making discretion

issues.issue: Does paragraph 117(9)(d) breach section 7 of the Charter (liberty or security of the person)?
issues.applicant_position: Barring her from sponsoring her sons deprives her of liberty (personal choices) and security (separation stress).
issues.result_quote: I am not persuaded that Ms de Guzman has been deprived of the constitutional rights to liberty and security of the person guaranteed by section 7 of the Charter.

issues.issue: Does paragraph 117(9)(d) make IRPA non-compliant with international human rights instruments under s.3(3)(f)?
issues.applicant_position: Regulation breaches binding instruments (ICCPR art. 17, CRC arts. 3(1), 10), which s.3(3)(f) makes determinative.
issues.result_quote: when considered with other provisions in IRPA, particularly section 25, paragraph 117(9)(d) does not make IRPA non-compliant
